motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Station fill and border changes, and primary action fill.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animation and transition duration when reduced motion is requested; animations run once.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Full-width action for starting or continuing practice.
components.html: <button class="ds-action">Let’s go<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 10h12M11 5l5 5-5 5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-action { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; width:100%; padding:16px 20px; background:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); color:white; border:1px solid var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); border-radius:5px; font:700 14px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-action:hover { background:#1937b3; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--atlas-coral, #d94632); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Answer option
components.description: A practice answer before a choice is made.
components.css: .ds-answer { min-height:58px; padding:12px; border:1px solid #a7b5cd; border-radius:5px; font:15px Manrope, sans-serif; color:var(--atlas-ink, #182c51); background:white; cursor:pointer; } .ds-answer:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#e7ecfc; border-color:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); } .ds-answer:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Selected station
components.description: Coral marks the current map location.
components.css: .ds-stop { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:11px; border:0; background:var(--atlas-ground, #f6f8fc); padding:18px; cursor:pointer; font:12px Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-station { display:grid; place-items:center; height:72px; width:72px; border:2px solid var(--atlas-coral, #d94632); border-radius:50%; background:var(--atlas-coral, #d94632); color:white; outline:5px solid #f4d6cf; outline-offset:5px; font:33px "BIZ UDPGothic",sans-serif; transition:background 180ms,border-color 180ms; } .ds-stop strong { color:#a32e1f; font-weight:800; } .ds-stop small { color:var(--atlas-muted, #53647c); font-size:10px; } .ds-stop:hover .ds-station { border-color:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); } .ds-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Current page is identified by a cobalt underline.
components.html: JourneyField guideAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; height:81px; background:var(--atlas-ground, #f6f8fc); border-bottom:1px solid var(--atlas-line, #d8e1ef); } .ds-nav a { display:flex; align-items:center; padding-top:3px; color:var(--atlas-muted, #53647c); font:700 14px Manrope,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); border-color:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Study table
components.description: A solid character field and a quiet meaning field.
components.css: .ds-study { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; min-height:280px; border:1px solid var(--atlas-line, #d8e1ef); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; font-family:Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-character { display:grid; place-items:center; padding:28px; color:white; background:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); font:100px/1.4 "BIZ UDPGothic",sans-serif; } .ds-meaning { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; padding:36px; color:var(--atlas-ink, #182c51); } .ds-meaning p { color:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); font-size:22px; margin:0 0 12px; } .ds-meaning h2 { font-size:26px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.3; letter-spacing:-.03em; margin:0; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Retained field-guide search with the shared paper and ink colors.
components.css: .ds-search { padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--color-divider, #d8e1ef); border-radius:12px; background:var(--color-paper, #f6f8fc); transition:box-shadow .3s ease,border-color .3s ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:var(--color-ai, #2849d8); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,145,255,.1); } .ds-search input { width:100%; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink, #182c51); caret-color:var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); font:500 16px Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--color-ink-ghost, #64748b); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--atlas-blue, #2849d8); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Common-word tag
components.description: Retained reference metadata for a common word.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-block; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:9999px; color:white; background:var(--color-matcha, #287050); font:700 10px Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The cobalt expedition atlas makes learning paths visible. Cool paper, blue ink, coral location marks, and green completion marks give each state a clear role. Japanese characters are the main visual landmarks. Compact controls and strong Manrope headings keep the course easy to scan.

The map, practice screen, field guide, and shared navigation use this system. Existing character, recipe, lookup, and profile pages keep their structures and inherit the new shared colors and display font. This record describes the source build; it does not claim that every older component has been redesigned. No raster assets ship with this redesign.
keyCharacteristics: Connected routes with visible branch and join points.
Large Japanese characters with clear English labels.
Flat surfaces, fine rules, and compact controls.
Progress shown through color, text, line style, and SVG badges.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for available actions, coral for the selected location, and green for earned progress. Keep text or a shape cue with each state.

rules.name: The Character Landmark Rule
rules.body: Use BIZ UDPGothic for study characters and route stations. Keep the character separate from the smaller interface label.

rules.name: The Flat Atlas Rule
rules.body: Use fills, borders, and route lines to separate the new atlas surfaces. Selection rings show state; they are not drop shadows.

dos: Do use the shared atlas variables for new surfaces.
Do show locked paths with dashed borders and a lock badge, and completed paths with a check badge and solid lines.
Do use the shared SVG RouteIcon for interface arrows and checks.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain a clear return path between practice, the selected stop, and the map.
donts: Don't use coral as the completion color.
Don't use a color change as the only progress signal.
Don't copy older neon effects or text glyph controls into new atlas components.
Don't treat the retained detail-page structures as a new atlas layout standard.
